entities.name: Ludevic of Ulm
entities.description: Wheezing, reclusive necro-alchemist of Havengul, and the most influential of Innistrad's merchants.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Young protege Ludevic trains in necro-alchemy.

entities.name: Kraum
entities.description: Hideous flying skaab created by Ludevic.

entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: Town where Kraum haunts and where Ludevic has a former student.

entities.name: Olag
entities.description: Ludevic's final creation, kind and innocent, locked beneath his laboratory.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Visited Ludevic to warn him of the invasion.

events.summary: Ludevic builds Olag as his final creation, but Olag is kind, so he locks them away.
events.quote: Olag remains locked away beneath the laboratory until Ludevic figures out how to fix them.

events.summary: Sorin Markov warns Ludevic of the Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: Sorin Markov visited Ludevic to inform him about the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Ludevic entrusts Geralf with the defense of Havengul and visits a former student in Selhoff.
events.quote: entrusted him with the defense of Havengul

events.summary: Geralf goes through an Omenpath as an experiment; Ludevic sends Kraum to watch him.
events.quote: Ludevic sent Kraum to keep an eye on him.

relations.quote: he has taken young Geralf Cecani under his wing and trains him in the arts of necro-alchemy
Ludevic is the creator of the hideous flying skaab Kraum
Calling his creation " Olag ", Ludevic activated his machines
